ja453:1.1: Kiṃ su naro jappam adhicca kāle kaṃ vā vijjaṃ katamaṃ vā sutānaṃ so macco asmiṃ va paramhi loke kathaṃkaro sotthānena gutto ti.
ja453:2.1: Yassa devā pitaro ca sabbe siriṃsapā sabbabhūtāni cāpi mettāya niccaṃ apacitāni honti bhūtesu ve sotthānaṃ tad āhū 'ti āha.
ja453:3.1: Yo sabbalokassa nivātavutti itthīpumānaṃ sahadārakānaṃ khantā duruttānaṃ apaṭikkūlavādī -- adhivāsanaṃ sotthānaṃ tad āhu.
ja453:4.1: Yo nāvajānāti sahāyamatte sippena kulyābhi dhanena jaccā rucipañño atthakāle mutīmā -- sahāyesu ve sotthānaṃ tad āhu.
ja453:5.1: Mittāni ve yassa bhavanti santo saṃvissatthā avisaṃvādakassa na mittadūbhī saṃvibhāgī dhanena -- mittesu ve sotthānaṃ tad āhu.
ja453:6.1: Yassa bhariyā tulyavayā samaggā anubbatā dhammakāmā pajātā koliniyā sīlavatī patibbatā -- dāresu ve sotthānaṃ tad āhu.
ja453:7.1: Yassa rājā bhūtapatī yasassī jānāti soceyyaṃ parakkamañ ca advejjhatā suhad ayaṃ maman ti -- rājūsu ve sotthānaṃ tad āhu.
ja453:8.1: Annañ ca pānañ ca dadāti saddho mālañ ca gandhañ ca vilepanañ ca pasannacitto anumodamāno -- saggesu ve sotthānaṃ tad āhu.
ja453:9.1: Yam ariyadhammena punanti vaddhā ārādhitā samacariyāya santo bahussutā isayo sīlavanto arahantamajjhe sotthānaṃ tad āhū 'ti imā gāthā āha.
ja453:10.1: Etāni kho sotthānāni loke viññūpasatthāni sukhindriyāni, tānīdha sevetha naro sapañño, na hi maṅgale kiñcanam atthi saccan ti.
